name: ergram
description: Talk on a Telegram group from Even Realities G2 smart glasses: push-to-talk voice, transcribed by Soniox and sent via a Telegram userbot.

scripts.pack: pnpm build && evenhub pack app.json dist -o ergram.ehpk
scripts.sim: concurrently -n vite,sim -c blue,green "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && evenhub-simulator http://localhost:5173 --automation-port 9898 ${ERGRAM_SIM_AID:+--aid $ERGRAM_SIM_AID}"
